title: Bootstrap Error Estimation and Sketch-Size Selection for Sketched Ridge Regression
summary: Randomized sketching reduces the computational cost of large ridge-regression problems, but the coefficient error depends on the realized sketch. We extend the paired-row bootstrap from randomized least squares to ridge regression, enabling coefficient-error estimation using only compressed data. Under a fixed coefficient dimension and increasing data and sketch sizes, we derive asymptotic linear representations and Gaussian limits for the sketched estimator and the conditional bootstrap distribution.
